title: Recipes: the newest first, and the filters as chips that open and close
boardTitle: DT347: the Recipes bar: Newest, Made by and Filters in one row; Filters opens a panel

opportunity.from: Coach Milan 23 November 2026, 19:03, after making a recipe (Lazy Burek): sort newest first by default; the filter section is a big block, maybe chips or another way to show and hide it. 26 November 10:43: sort as chips too? Newest first and the default; how to solve the tension of so many chips at once.
opportunity.job: Find a recipe, often the one I just made.
opportunity.kind: Too much at once: twelve things to tap before the first recipe.
opportunity.why_now: The Recipes batch in Now (B164, DT347, DT346), with the design rules applied.

problem: At rest the Recipes bar shows twelve things to tap under the search: Made by ▾, Kitchen ▾, Moment ▾, Fits my day, No cooking, With my foods, then Sort with six words as text links. The bar is 250 px high, its chips 32 px. The sort is text, though picking one of six is an answer (a chip, D3), and its default is For your day, so the recipe I just made is not on top.
story: When I open Recipes, I want the list right under a short bar, with the newest first, so that I find the recipe I just made and open the filters only when I need them.
now: Under the search: Made by ▾, Kitchen ▾, Moment ▾, Fits my day, No cooking, With my foods; then Sort: For your day (underlined), Newest, Most made, Highest PD, Quickest, A to Z as text links. Kitchen opens its list under the chips.
proposed: Coach Milan 11:46 to 12:16: one row under the search: the sort first, Newest ▾, then Made by: All ▾, both showing their choice, blue (a sort and Made by always hold one); then Filters ▾, the one place to pick several. Filters opens a panel downwards with every filter, top to bottom, all as the same rows under section headings, 18 px bold, as the groups' titles on Recipes (B164; 12:40: the block's heading more prominent): Kitchen and Meal (one of each; Meal was Moment, 12:35: not our word), PD by ranges (12:41): Any PD, PD under 4, PD 4 to 6, PD 6 to 8, PD 8 and more, whole numbers that hold the five goals' bands (N5), the range with my target saying your target 4.8, in % when I read PD as %; then For me (12:35: no More, a filter with its own name): Fits my day, No cooking, With my foods (and Served, when there are plates to explore), where several can be on (12:29: the same pattern to the end); at the end Clear all and Show 6 recipes, the main step, filled, on the right (D7, D8), which says what you get and closes the panel. With some set, the chip says Filters · 2, blue. The sort opens as chips under the row, Newest first; a tap picks and closes it. Newest is the default. The bar's chips are 44 px (D10), round (D16), white until chosen and blue with a check when chosen (D6). Three things to tap at rest instead of twelve; the bar is 155 px high instead of 250.
looked_at: The filters in one row that scrolls sideways (drawn 12:10): not chosen, 12:12: filters off to the side are missed; a panel downwards is what people know from shops and booking sites. All the filters always in sight (main): not chosen, twelve things before the first recipe. A plain Close at the end of the panel: not chosen, Show 6 recipes says what the tap does (D10). Keep the sort as text: not chosen, picking one of six is an answer, a chip (D3). Fits my day, No cooking and With my foods as chips inside the panel (drawn 12:25): not chosen, 12:29: the panel continues the same way, rows to the end. More as the third group's title (drawn 12:35): not chosen, 12:35: it has to be a filter with its own name; For me, because all three are about me: my day, my foods, my time.
decision: Go 26 November 2026, 12:52; checks Light plus the German sweep, 12 of 12 (docs/qa/runs/0.3.199.json), 789 unit tests. Built in 0.3.199.
short: Newest, Made by: All, Filters in one row; Filters opens a panel with Show N recipes; release 0.3.199

ac.title: One row at rest
ac.text: Given Recipes with 9 recipes, when I open it, then under the search there is one row, Newest ▾ and Made by: All ▾ (both blue) and Filters ▾, each 44 px high; no Kitchen, Meal, Fits my day, No cooking, With my foods or Sort words on screen

ac.title: Newest first, by default
ac.text: Given my recipes saved on different days, when I open Recipes, then the newest is first, and the sort chip says Newest

ac.title: The sort as chips
ac.text: Given that, when I tap Newest ▾, then six chips open under the row, Newest, For your day, Most made, Highest PD, Quickest, A to Z, Newest blue with a check; when I tap Highest PD, they close, the chip says Highest PD ▾ and the list follows

ac.title: Filters opens a panel
ac.text: Given that, when I tap Filters ▾, then a panel opens downwards with the same rows throughout: Kitchen and its kitchens, Meal and its meals, For me with Fits my day, No cooking, With my foods; at the end Clear all and Show 9 recipes

ac.title: Show N recipes
ac.text: Given the panel, when I tap No cooking and With my foods, then both rows show a check and the button says Show 6 recipes; when I tap it, the panel closes, the chip says Filters · 2, blue, and the line under says 6 of 9 recipes · No cooking · With my foods with Clear all

ac.title: PD by ranges
ac.text: Given my PD target 4.8 and recipes at PD 3.1, 4.3, 6.9 and 8.7, when I open Filters, then PD lists Any PD, PD under 4, PD 4 to 6 (your target 4.8), PD 6 to 8, PD 8 and more; when I tap PD 6 to 8, only the recipe at 6.9 is left and the line under says PD 6 to 8

ac.title: Made by keeps its list
ac.text: Given that, when I tap Made by: All ▾ and Me, then the chip says Made by: Me ▾ and only my recipes are listed

ac.title: In every language
ac.text: Given Srpski or German, when I open Recipes and Filters, then the chips, the panel and Show N recipes are in that language, with the right ending for the number

unchanged: The search and what it finds.
Made by ▾ and its list with counts.
What each filter and each sort does; the line under the bar with Clear all.
checks: Light plus the German sweep: the Recipes bar and its words. The unit tests (the sorts' order, the PD ranges and their filter); the build; recipes-bar with new checks for AC1 to AC8 (it covers the bar, DT126c), and the walkthroughs that tap Kitchen, Moment, the three chips or a sort today change with the story, each with a note; design-rules, accessibility, deutsch, language. About 12 walkthroughs, 4 minutes. Words new (Srpski and German): recipebar.sortIs (Sort: {sort}, the sort chip's screen reader label), recipebar.filtersN (Filters · {n}), recipebar.more (For me), recipebar.showN (Show {n} recipes, counted). Changed English (Srpski and German follow): rb.moment Moment becomes Meal, recipebar.anyMoment Any moment becomes Any meal. New too: rf.pdTitle, rf.pdAny, rf.pd.under, rf.pd.range, rf.pd.over, rf.pd.yours.
details: src/components/RecipeBar.tsx: one row: the sort chip (rb-sort-chip, on), Made by (on, Made by: All when none), Filters (rb-filters-chip, Filters · n when set); the sort's six chips open under it; Filters opens rb-panel: Kitchen, Meal and For me as rb-line rows (For me's rows each on or off), rb-panel-actions with Clear all (keeps the search and Made by) and Show N recipes (closes it); the line under the bar hides while the panel is open. src/recipeFilter.ts: SORTS starts with new. src/screens/RecipesScreen.tsx: the default sort is new. src/index.css: .rb-chips .choice 44 px; .rb-panel; a chosen chip shows its check, a drop-down chip does not. .rb .rb-sheet-title: --fs-section (18 px), bold, ink, no capitals (the Sort and Made by sheets too). src/recipeFilter.ts: Filters.pd (lt4, 4to6, 6to8, 8up), PDS, pdRangeLabel, pdRangeOf; RecipesScreen passes the target to the bar.
The pictures: before from main, 0.3.198; new from a scratch build of main with the change, not committed. Members' names are invented.
Near: DT352 (Later, find a recipe by meal and my PD target) gets part of its way here: Meal and PD as filters. It stays for the search by my target itself.
